description_en: Queries the task result of a database dry run node
description_zh: 查询数据库预检任务结果
kebab_example: aliyun sas query-pre-check-database --task-id t-000bc9nqwxsbyvod0000 --instance-uuid ebc895506c6911ed800000163e0e0000 --uni-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryPreCheckDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database pre-check task.
> You can call the [StartPreCheckDatabase](~~StartPreCheckDatabase~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库预检任务ID。
> 您可以调用[StartPreCheckDatabase](~~StartPreCheckDatabase~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the server database backup client.
> You can call the [DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器数据库备份客户端唯一标识。
>调用[DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_uuid

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the database server
parameters.help_zh: 数据库服务器所在的地域ID
parameters.name: uni_region_id
